title: Release thread: hold Orion cutover until soak results are clean
body:
#proj-orion-release thread

Priya: Replica lag is still above threshold; hold cutover until soak results are clean.
Alex: Customer Engineering says Acme Corp needs a status update before end of day because monthly close reporting is exposed.
Mina: Linking ORION-1473 and the release readiness runbook. We should not proceed without validation below the lag threshold.
Sam: PR-1287 is merged but we need one more load test before reopening the cutover window.
Decision: delay the cutover, publish customer-facing status, and resume only after lag remains under threshold for the full soak period.

title: Read replica lag causing delayed cutover
body: During the staging cutover for Project Orion, read replica lag exceeded the release threshold during peak load. Blue/Green validation cannot complete while the replica remains behind primary writes. Impact: staging and production-readiness validation are blocked, with risk to customer go-live commitments. Current mitigation is to hold cutover, run an extended soak test, and validate failover behavior after connection pool changes from PR-1287.

title: Orion release readiness: architecture and risks
body: The Orion readiness runbook lists database failover, rollback decision points, customer commitments, and report-generation validation as release gates. Known risk: replica lag during cutover may exceed the rollback threshold and delay the release. Required evidence before proceed: clean soak results, Jira blocker ORION-1473 closed or downgraded, and customer communication complete for affected accounts.

title: Customer escalation: report generation delays
body: Acme Corp reports customer-visible report generation delays affecting monthly close commitments. Customer commitment: provide a resolution update by May 3 and confirm whether the Orion cutover delay changes the go-live plan. Linked evidence references ORION-1473 for replica lag and the Slack release thread for the decision to hold cutover until soak results are clean.

title: Improve connection pool failover behavior
body: This pull request improves connection pool rebalancing during replica promotion and reduces failover recovery time. It is linked to ORION-1473 and the May 2 cutover delay. Validation notes: rerun the soak test after merge, confirm replica lag remains under threshold, and update the Orion release readiness page before reopening the cutover window.
